inputs.name: Presence
inputs.description: Extends the comfort temperature period when high. Switches from eco to comfort after a specified configuration parameter.

inputs.name: Door window contact
inputs.description: If active longer than configured duration: 1) switches off heating for open door or window if outside temperature is lower than target, 2) switches off cooling if outside temperature is higher than target

inputs.name: Comfort mode
inputs.description: Activates the comfort temperature mode until the next schedule period change.

inputs.name: Eco mode
inputs.description: Activates the eco temperature mode until the next schedule period change.

outputs.description: Output expressing the heating or cooling requirement expressed as a difference between a current and a target temperature. Positive for heating. Negative for cooling.
outputs.name: Climate control

config.name: Thermal mode
config.description: Defines the thermal mode: 0=heating and cooling, 1=heating only, 2=cooling only

config.name: Eco heating temperature diff
config.description: Eco heating temperature diff. below the comfort temp.

config.name: Eco cooling temperature diff
config.description: Eco cooling temperature diff. above the comfort temp.

config.name: DWC delay in seconds
config.description: Door, window contact delay in seconds. Prevents short door, window opening to interrupt the climate control.

config.name: Presence extension duration
config.description: Comfort temperature extension duration (in seconds) on presence detection.

state.name: Current DWC state
state.description: Used to prevent DWC duration extension on re-sending the same input
